name: Digital logic

reference.adaptation: Extract one NAND gate from the four-part source; use generic logical pin numbers, the 741 body size and yellow fill, and native hidden power pins named VCC and VSS.

notes: Original configurable educational SPICE models are embedded. Clocked symbols include both edge variants; physical footprints and manufacturer timing remain separate.

descriptions.gate_and: Y is high only when both A and B are high.
descriptions.gate_nand: Y is low only when both A and B are high.
descriptions.gate_or: Y is high when either A or B is high.
descriptions.gate_nor: Y is high only when both A and B are low.
descriptions.gate_xor: Y is high when A and B are different.
descriptions.gate_xnor: Y is high when A and B are the same.
descriptions.gate_not: Y is the inverse of A: high input gives low output.
descriptions.full_adder: Adds A, B and CARRY_IN. SUM is the low bit; CARRY_OUT is high when at least two inputs are high.
descriptions.decoder2to4: Drives one of Y0–Y3 high according to A1:A0 while ENABLE is high. All outputs are low when disabled.
descriptions.encoder4to2: Encodes the highest asserted input I0–I3 as Y1:Y0. VALID is high when any input is asserted.
descriptions.mux2: Routes D0 to Y when SELECT is low, or D1 when SELECT is high.
descriptions.counter_bcd: Counts 0–9 on the {edge} clock edge while ENABLE is high. UP_DOWN high counts up; low counts down. RESET high clears the count.
descriptions.counter_binary3_async: Three ripple-clocked stages count 0–7. The first stage uses the {edge} clock edge. ENABLE high enables counting; UP_DOWN high counts up. RESET high clears the count.
descriptions.counter_binary3_sync: Counts 0–7 on the {edge} clock edge while ENABLE is high. UP_DOWN high counts up; low counts down. RESET high clears the count.
descriptions.counter_johnson: Cycles through 0, 1, 3, 7, 15, 14, 12, 8 on the {edge} clock edge while ENABLE is high. RESET high clears the state.
descriptions.shift_register3: Shifts DATA into Q0, then Q1 and Q2, on each {edge} clock edge. RESET high clears all three stages.
descriptions.flipflop_d: Copies D to Q on the {edge} clock edge. SET_N and RESET_N are asynchronous active-low controls; reset takes priority.
descriptions.flipflop_jk: On the {edge} clock edge: J/K = 00 holds, 10 sets, 01 resets and 11 toggles Q. Asynchronous SET_N/RESET_N are active-low; reset takes priority.
descriptions.latch_d: Q follows D while ENABLE is high and holds its value while ENABLE is low. Q_N is the inverse of Q.
descriptions.latch_rs: SET high sets Q; RESET high clears Q. Both low hold the state. RESET takes priority when both are high.
